handwriting_models.label: German Kurrent, 19th century
handwriting_models.description: Handwritten German in Kurrent script, 19th century. Trained mainly on Swiss records such as Federal Council minutes and parliamentary protocols. Character error rate 7.7% on unseen hands (Federal Council minutes 1848-1903).
handwriting_models.prompt: Transcribe the handwritten text in this image exactly as written.

handwriting_models.label: Medieval German, 14th-17th century
handwriting_models.description: Handwritten medieval and early modern German. Trained on the Rats- und Richtebuecher, the Bullinger correspondence, the Koenigsfelden charters and the AAEB collections. Character error rate about 14%.
handwriting_models.prompt: Transcribe the handwritten text in this image exactly as written.
